svg.title: Contribution world · a year drawn as a skyline
svg.desc: 886 contributions over 61 active days from Nov 16, 2025 to Nov 21, 2026. Peak day: 86 on Nov 16, 2026. Busiest weekday: Monday. Longest streak: 5 days, Aug 17–21. Momentum: +337% (Nov 1–21 over Oct 1–21). Weeks before the account joined are drawn as open water under a rising sun, with a ship sailing toward the lighthouse where the land begins. Tower height and colour show each day's contributions, from gold on light days to crimson on the busiest. A red moon, red clouds and a distant skyline sit on the right. Open the contribution explorer to inspect the calendar.

g.text: · tower height is the day's count
